name: Sourav Kumar
headline: Software Developer · AI / ML Enthusiast
tagline: Building intelligent experiences at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and thoughtful design.

education.school: Jaypee University of Engineering and Technology
education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering

points: Implemented Non-Uniformity Correction (NUC) methods and LSC-CNN to enhance infrared image quality for thermal imaging applications.
Developed and trained CNN and Deep Filter Neural Networks for infrared image denoising and correction.
Designed deep learning workflows in PyTorch for imaging and restoration tasks.
Conducted data research, collection, and validation across educational datasets.
Used Python and Microsoft Excel for cleaning, analysis, and reporting.
Prepared structured reports and maintained high-quality data records.

projects.title: E-commerce Conversion Prediction
projects.subtitle: Personalized Campaign Optimization
projects.description: A conversion propensity model that uses behavioral signals and funnel analysis to estimate purchase intent and inform targeted campaigns.
details: Modeled purchase likelihood using views, clicks, cart events, devices, and user history.
Compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost using ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision, and recall.
Segmented customers into low, medium, and high purchase-intent groups.

projects.title: AI-Powered Smart Product Pricing
projects.subtitle: Visual Attribute Extraction
projects.description: A multimodal pricing system combining text, images, and structured attributes with OCR extraction and machine learning.
details: Extracted product weight, volume, and dimensions from images with an OCR pipeline.
Fused NLP, image, and structured features for price prediction using LightGBM.
Built using FastAPI, React.js, Docker, and PyTorch.

achievements: Solved 950+ Data Structures and Algorithms problems on LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, HackerRank, and CodeChef.
Qualified for the third phase as a solo participant in RideHack’24 at JIIT (Innovation-Startup track).
Qualified for the Smart India Hackathon (SIH) Internal 2025 at JUET.
Coordinator at Rospinot and Mozilla clubs, supporting community initiatives and collaboration.
Hacktoberfest 2025 Supercontributor with 6+ accepted open-source PRs/MRs.
